reasoning: PCA produces coordinates in a principal-component representation, whether all components or a proper subset are retained. This does not itself assign cluster membership. findings: The exact v3 repair resolves the v2 blocker: principal-component representation remains true whether a full or truncated component set is retained. No retained-component-count assumption is needed.
